_note: THE SCORECARD (owner ruling, 1 Nov 2026: "nothing runs unmeasured"; plan https://claude.ai/artifact/NA78ECyBGeB5aHfWkeGqZe). One row per initiative: the result that counts (never activity), a code-readable source (a reader id in scripts/ops/lib/scorecard-readers.mjs), a first floor by day 30 and a real floor by day 60 (slow channels say longer), a version B written at build time, and an owner. Every job in src/shared/boss/schedule/manifest.json is in exactly one row's jobs OR in exempt with its reason; tests/scorecard.test.ts fails the build otherwise. A new scheduled job, sender, outreach series, pin feed or page loop gets its row here in the same PR. The Monday run (scripts/ops/scorecard-monday.mjs) reads every row; state and history live in Boss OS (GET /api/boss/scorecard), not in this file.
